test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only three people sit between G and F. Only two people sit to the left of G. B is not an immediate neighbour of F. B sits second to the right of D. C sits to the immediate right of E. Who sits at the extreme left end of the row?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G.

Only three people sit between G and F.

Only two people sit to the left of G.

B is not an immediate neighbour of F.

B sits second to the right of D.

C sits to the immediate right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0303faeab016a4c3b3e85f71d05893f0ea0ce5c33b6c4f0727085813c7e45f0b.png] 

Thus, **A** sits at the extreme left end of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
